Name: Basic

Sections.Name: Shape
Sections.Label: Shape
Sections.Description: Primary form, amplitude, and profile controls.

Params.Name: SubStyle
Params.Description: Selects the basic profile used by the flat-shape generator.
Params.Tooltip: Choose a different sub-style to change the overall form.

Params.Name: SinWaveType
Params.Description: Selects the coordinate combination used by the sine-wave sub-style.
Params.Tooltip: Choose the direction or combination of wave axes.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Description: Controls the frequency of the selected wave pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Increase frequency for more bands across the terrain.

Params.Name: Height
Params.Description: Controls the vertical height of the generated feature.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Description: Controls the size of the primary radial feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase radius to affect a larger area.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Description: Generates a basic-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
